prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1372; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in Houston, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright. I'm the driver of the blue sedan that was hit.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened as you approached the intersection?

A: I had a green light and I was going straight through. I was maybe a few car lengths from the crossing when a pickup coming from my right just kept going. It didn't stop for its red. It came straight into the driver's side of my car.

Q: How fast do you estimate you were traveling?

A: Not fast, probably around the speed limit, maybe a little under because traffic was thick.

Q: Did you have a chance to brake or swerve before impact?

A: I hit the brakes as soon as I saw him, but there wasn't time to avoid it. The impact was hard and on my side of the car.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt, and did the airbags deploy?

A: Yes, I was belted. The side curtain airbag came out. My head hit the window and my shoulder slammed into the door frame.

Q: Where are you experiencing injuries now?

A: My right shoulder is the worst of it. I can't lift my arm above my chest without sharp pain. I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon and they took X-rays and told me to see a specialist.

Q: Have you seen anyone since then?

A: I have an appointment with an orthopedic doctor next week for an MRI. I've been taking pain medication and doing some of the exercises they gave me.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?

A: Only that I didn't do anything to cause this. I was following the rules and I'm trying to get back to work.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
